Tracleer 2016 exists twice in this dataset: Actelion's annual CHF 1,020, which normalises to USD 1,033.06 at this repo's rate, and the four quarters J&J republished in dollars, which sum to 1,035. Both are the same year of the same product; the 1.94 between them is two conversion paths, not a restatement. It resolves - but only just, and comparing the as-reported figures (1,020 against 1,035) would report an impossible contradiction that is purely a currency. The adjudicator's own false-positive guard tripped on exactly this before it was fixed to compare normalised USD on both sides.
